item.title: U.S. Agency for Global Media Clamps Down on Grantee Rogue Behavior
item.description: The U.S. Agency for Global Media (USAGM) is setting the record straight after a wave of misleading press reports and troubling financial claims pushed out by its own federal grantee, Radio Free Asia (RFA). The grantee, funded entirely by hardworking American taxpayers, has launched into a series of reckless moves, auctioning off broadcast and technology equipment, cutting staff, and suddenly abandoning property. item.title: U.S. Agency for Global Media Announces New National Security Policy
item.description: U.S. Agency for Global Media announces new National Security policy. Effective December 23, 2025, all USAGM personnel should be familiar with this Strategy and use it, as appropriate, as a framework for programming, consistent with the broadcasting standards and principles set forth in the International Broadcasting Act.
